_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::particle_sph#10. Two neighbouring thermal material keys, opposite failure modes. CONDUCTIVITY_REACHED_RESULT_TESTS=no rules out the plausible-sounding alternative that the temperature field merely freezes -- the run does not finish at all.
